title: Info Registration 42K Valencia 2026 — loyalty period, ballot and waiting list
claims: The 2026 entry process keeps a four-day loyalty period for 2025 participants, then opens a public ballot for the remaining places until the 36,000 bib quota is allocated.

2026 cycle dates: loyalty 11-15 December; ballot registration 16-26 December; draw before a notary on 12 January; results emailed 13 January; winners register 13-26 January; unfilled places go to the waiting list on 26 January.
Ballot entry is free but requires an active bank card on which a €5 hold is placed for at most 15 days; the hold is released automatically whether or not the runner wins a place.
Ballot personal details cannot be changed later; one entry per person is allowed; group entries are limited to three people with separate email addresses.
Runners selected in the ballot must complete purchase within 12 days, or the reserved bib is cancelled and allocated to the waiting list in registration order.
Loyalty and ballot bibs allow a holder transfer from 1 February; ballot bibs freed by a holder change are offered exclusively to waiting-list runners.
